name: Vágáshuta (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vágáshuta: a blue and green shield with hills, a glass furnace and two figures, between oak and pine branches, above a yellow scroll inscribed VÁGÁSHUTA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vágáshuta arms with branches and scroll
